intentions: Allow exporting filtered expenses to CSV files for external analysis
Build a CLI interface using Click with nested command groups for managing categories, budgets, and expenses
Define and manage expense categories with unique names, descriptions, optional monthly budgets, and icons
Detect recurring expenses based on amount and category patterns
Enable foreign key constraints in SQLite to maintain referential integrity between models
Enable monthly and yearly financial reporting with budget status (on_track, warning, exceeded)
Enforce budget constraints via a unique (category_id, month) constraint on the budget table to prevent duplicate entries
Ensure all monetary values are stored as integers (cents) to avoid floating-point errors
Implement custom exception classes for common errors: CategoryNotFoundError, ExpenseNotFoundError, BudgetExceededException
Implement robust SQLite-based repositories for category, expense, and budget data with CRUD operations and filtering capabilities
Provide business logic in a service layer that validates data, checks budget limits, aggregates spending, and generates reports
Store and retrieve expenses with detailed metadata including amount in cents, date, category, payment method, and recurrence status
Support filtering and querying expenses by category, date range, payment method, and recurrence
Use auto-incremented primary keys with optional ID fields in domain models
